_doc: Mine-type table for scan simulator v2 (SPEC 4.5.1). Classes describe EMI detectability: metal = metal body or large metal parts; low_metal = plastic body with metal limited to the fuze; non_metal = no EMI-detectable metal (sensitivity analysis only).

sources.GICHDUA: GICHD, Explosive Ordnance Guide for Ukraine, 2nd ed., 2022
sources.ITEP04: ITEP/US Army HSTAMIDS vs VMH-1, Thailand 2004
sources.HRW23: Human Rights Watch, Landmine Use in Ukraine, 2023

PMN-2.class_source: GICHDUA: injection-moulded plastic body; BRU: metal content of some grams; NLM: generally easy to detect with a good metal detector
PMN-2.emplacement_source: ITEP04 test depth; FM3342 notes PMN surface-laid by mine layers (surface in doctrinal regime)

PMN-4.class_source: GICHDUA: plastic casing over an alloy pressure plate; not a minimum metal mine and relatively easy to detect
PMN-4.emplacement_source: assumption: blast AP mine, buried as PMN-2

OZM-72.class_source: GICHDUA: sheet-steel outer body with pre-formed chopped steel rod fragments; OZMW: iron casing, 5 kg
OZM-72.emplacement_source: GICHDUA: casing will very likely remain buried in the ground

PFM-1.class_source: OK26: minimal metal, 50-100 g; GICHDUA: fuze largely aluminium, ferrous springs and locking balls
PFM-1.emplacement_source: GICHDUA: scatterable, usually found on the surface

TM-62M.class_source: GICHDUA: metal-bodied AV blast mine; TM62W: most widely employed TM-62 variant
TM-62M.emplacement_source: ITEP04 AT test depth; assumption: buried in residual fields

TM-62P3.class_source: GICHDUA: plastic-bodied; with MVP fuze can be deemed a minimum metal mine; MVP-62M striker, springs and detonator detectable with modern EMI

high.source: assumption: width around ITEP04 nominal AP 5 cm, within OK26 0-20 cm

low.source: assumption: width around ITEP04 nominal AT 10 cm

residual_mix._source: HRW23: hand-emplaced TM-62 series most frequently deployed AV type; TM62W: TM-62M most widely employed variant; TM-62M/TM-62P3 0.6/0.4 ratio and AP equal weights are assumption; surface scatterables excluded (assumption: visible, removed by visual clearance)

TM-62M.source: assumption: TM-62 series 0.5 of mix (HRW23 most frequent) x 0.6 (TM62W)

TM-62P3.source: assumption: TM-62 series 0.5 of mix x 0.4

PMN-2.source: assumption: AP buried types equal weights

PMN-4.source: assumption: AP buried types equal weights

OZM-72.source: assumption: AP buried types equal weights

TM-62M.source: assumption: ratio; HRW23/TM62W TM-62M most widely employed
